notes.title: Leaderboards and Balance
notes.content:
Hey guys, hope you guys are enjoying the game. I will be resetting the leaderboards the 1st of each month to give new players a chance to shine at being number 1. Additionally, if anyone has balance requests or want to see anything else in the game, leave a message, i'll see what I can do :). 

Enjoy, 

Tanny Tran
